annotations.title: The result of an uploaded test or form check

description: The result of a fitness test the runner uploaded to a link from get_test_upload_link (or the summary of a free form check from get_form_check_link): for a fitness test, threshold pace and heart rate where measured, LT1 pace, FatMax, VO₂max, VLamax, economy, glycogen and predicted 5 km, 10 km and half-marathon times where the test gives them, every training zone, how sure Sigwren is and why, and what the result rests on. For a form check it returns what they do well, what to work on, the one focus and the cues; the full read is emailed to the runner. If nothing has been uploaded yet it says so; if the file could not be used it says why in plain words; if the link has expired it says that. Pass link (the URL, or its last part). Paces are in the units the runner chose on the upload page. It needs no account.

link.description: The link from get_test_upload_link or get_form_check_link (https://sigwren.com/u/…), or just its last part.
